metadata.description: Agentic Rails lifecycle guardrails for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex.

plugins.name: local-advisor-guardrail
plugins.description: Local child-agent advisor using Cursor Grok 4.5 High inside Cursor.

plugins.name: claude-as-advisor-guardrail
plugins.description: Read-only Claude advisor with harness config, health self-disable, and help/init/health skills. Defaults to Opus at high effort.

plugins.name: claude-as-critic-guardrail
plugins.description: Read-only Claude critic with harness config, health self-disable, and help/init/health skills. Defaults to Opus at high effort.

plugins.name: cursor-as-critic-guardrail
plugins.description: Read-only Cursor Grok 4.6 High critic guardrail at standard speed.

plugins.name: python-uv-guardrail
plugins.description: Requires uv for Python and pip commands.

plugins.name: readme-name-guardrail
plugins.description: Reserves README.md for the project root.

plugins.name: claude-home-fence-guardrail
plugins.description: Blocks Cursor agents from accessing Claude Code's ~/.claude home tree.

plugins.name: cursor-as-advisor-guardrail
plugins.description: Configurable read-only Cursor advisor guardrail defaulting to Grok 4.6 High at standard speed.

plugins.name: rails-marketplace-doctor
plugins.description: Read-only diagnosis for Agentic Rails Cursor marketplace and plugin cache freshness.

plugins.name: rails-marketplace-surgeon
plugins.description: Experimental, explicit cache repair for stale Agentic Rails Cursor plugin payloads.
